page_contract: The learner should understand that a neuron can be rewritten as a = sigma(sum(x_i w_i) + b) because the same five dendrites, synapses, soma, hillock and axon visibly retain identity while becoming the corresponding terms.

chars.counting_rule: UTF-8 decoded characters in authored runtime index.html and visual.js; excludes shared chassis, bundled libraries, selfcheck, documentation, reports and screenshots

changes: Named each biological trunk specification by angle, endpoint, bend and branch count instead of relying on positional numeric tuples.
Derived formula readiness thresholds once from the canonical authored beats instead of rebuilding a duplicate truth table on every animation frame.
Centralized owned event listeners and teardown so controls, media-query changes, keyboard input and pagehide cannot drift apart.
Reused one Canvas context and allocation-free path loops in the hot render path.
Centralized exact circle and text primitives while retaining every draw call's order, font, color, alpha and geometry.
Reused canonical beat positions, the chassis clamp and equivalent CSS inset geometry without shortening semantic identifiers or minifying source.
Cross-audit added a failure-only visible formula correspondence when the shared chassis or Canvas 2D renderer is unavailable; the normal deterministic renderer and all draw calls remain unchanged.
Cross-audit split 130-166 character geometry and keyboard expressions, naming the inner soma and weight callout anchor; the longest JavaScript line is now 129 characters.

tests.name: fixed-state DOM and pixel equivalence
tests.evidence: All key states, six in-between morphs and reduced final states retained equal DOM/controller evidence and paired screenshots.

tests.name: deterministic geometry and logical Canvas
tests.evidence: All 14 logical Canvas PNG hashes matched baseline; repeated candidate loads reproduced the same hashes, including the biological seed, an intermediate morph and the final formula network.

tests.name: authored controller
tests.evidence: All seven direct buttons, ArrowLeft/Right, Home, End, R, Space, play, pause, continue, reset, replay and rapid interruption produced a baseline-equal 18-state trace.

tests.name: pointer, keyboard and touch access
tests.evidence: The complete enabled Tab order, Enter activation and real touch taps reached the same authored states; Reset correctly remains out of the initial Tab order while disabled.

tests.name: reduced motion
tests.evidence: A preference change immediately exposes the complete formula state; direct state selection remains immediate and preserves all correspondence evidence.

tests.name: resize and lifecycle
tests.evidence: Live resize to 1280x720 retained one logical 1464x552 Canvas with viewport-equal scroll bounds; pagehide froze active playback and removed controls, while reload restored one canonical initial instance.

tests.name: selfcheck
tests.evidence: Initial and final states reported zero clipping, escaped content, overlap, tiny text, intrusion, failed resources or JavaScript errors.

tests.name: normal runtime
tests.evidence: The state, input, motion, resize and lifecycle run reported zero page errors, console errors or failed requests.

author_layer.excluded: shared chassis, vendor bundle, selfcheck, documentation, reports and screenshots
author_layer.readability: HTML/CSS 296 lines/max 115; JavaScript 572/max 129. Biological geometry, deterministic seed, formula thresholds, six morph windows, render primitives, controller and lifecycle remain explicit and semantic; no minification.

cross_audit.revision: The prior candidate threw when Deck was missing and left an empty claim when Canvas 2D was unavailable. A failure-only six-part correspondence now preserves a = sigma(sum(x_i w_i) + b), disables invalid controls, fits the viewport and owns fallback resize/pagehide. Composite geometry and key-routing lines were also split without changing evaluation or draw order.

evidence.model_and_canvas: Seven named states and six intermediate morphs deeply match formal DOM, formula readiness and Canvas dataURL. All 14 named-state Canvas SHA-256 values are identical across formal/candidate and across 1600x900/1280x720, proving deterministic seed, geometry and draw order remained live rather than precomputed.
evidence.pixel: Fresh run: 22 formal/candidate pairs cover seven named states at both sizes, both reduced final states and six intermediate morphs. Eighteen are AE0; four show only isolated controller line/dot raster noise up to max-AE7 and <=100 pixels. The prior 30-pair fixed-state run remains AE0, while the decisive Canvas hashes are exactly equal.
evidence.motion_and_inputs: 6200ms play, pause, continue, seven direct beats, 520ms rapid retarget, keyboard Home/End/Arrow/R/Space, real touch tap, double reset and reduced immediate final all pass.
evidence.resize: 1600x900 to 1280x720 preserves one logical 1464x552 Canvas, 0.8 screen scale and no visible overflow.
evidence.fallback: Aborting base.js or forcing getContext() to return null shows all six component-to-formula mappings, marks the full formula ready, disables controls, fits 1280x720 and raises no page error.
evidence.lifecycle: pagehide freezes active playback and makes cached controls/keys inert; reload restores one Canvas, seven beats and canonical 0% state.
evidence.selfcheck: Initial and final states: zero clipping, escape, overlap, tiny text, intrusion, failed resource or JavaScript error.

cross_audit.mini: required_if_used_as_auxiliary; improved full is above 10,000 author characters

rejected_changes.change: encode geometry, phase windows or beats as anonymous compressed tuples
rejected_changes.reason: would save characters by making the mechanism and correspondence harder for an Agent to learn

rejected_changes.change: remove dendrite branches, organelles, terminal paths, labels, morph phases or controller states
rejected_changes.reason: would lower biological identity, explanatory continuity or visual quality

rejected_changes.change: replace the deterministic Canvas renderer with captured media or precomputed frames
rejected_changes.reason: would discard the real geometry, interpolation, reset and reduced-motion implementation
